statement: Let P ⊂ M be an irreducible inclusion of II1 factors, and put Q = Pω ⊂ Mω = M. For every linear subspace X ⊂ M that is separable in 2-norm and satisfies τ(x) = 0 for all x ∈ X, there is a diffuse abelian von Neumann algebra A ⊂ Q such that τ(x0a1x1 · · · amxm) = 0 (2.1) whenever m ≥ 1, x0 ∈ X ∪ {1}, x1, . . . , xm ∈ X, and a1, . . . , am ∈ A have trace zero.
